name: 木板道 · Feld 壁画
blurb: 海风从废弃建筑的裂口里穿过，剥落的旧标语还留在墙面上。继续找 Ruby，就得从这里开始把半岛一块块翻过去。

points.label: 褪色的 Feld 壁画 · Kim 说该把半岛翻一遍
points.show_when: Variable["TASK.ruby_not_village_explore_peninsula"] == true or Variable["TASK.inspect_mural"] == true or Variable["TASK.ask_about_ruby_in_village_done"] == true

points.label: 标语旁的锈梯
points.show_when: Variable["TASK.locate_ruby_on_the_coast"] == true and Variable["TASK.locate_ruby_on_the_coast_done"] == false and Variable["TASK.climb_ladder_done"] == false

points.label: 木板道下的排水管
points.show_when: Variable["TASK.locate_ruby_on_the_coast"] == true and Variable["TASK.locate_ruby_on_the_coast_done"] == false and Variable["TASK.explore_the_passages"] == false

points.label: 从里面给 Kim 打开维修门

exits.label: 进入 Feld 楼下的黑暗通道
exits.show_when: (Variable["TASK.explore_the_passages"] == true and Variable["TASK.explore_the_passages_done"] == false) or (Variable["TASK.enter_cavern"] == true and Variable["TASK.enter_cavern_done"] == false) or (Variable["TASK.search_tent"] == true and Variable["TASK.search_tent_done"] == false) or (Variable["TASK.read_ruby_journal"] == true and Variable["TASK.read_ruby_journal_done"] == false)
